name: Environment Map as Image-Based Lighting
definition: Using an environment map to simulate lighting from the outer environment (sky, sunlight) which is hard to model as solid objects, avoiding the task of modeling all objects from the border of the bounding environment to the shading point and accumulating indirect lighting between any two objects.
summary: Environment Map as Image-Based Lighting simulates distant illumination by treating the outer environment as an infinitely far sphere, avoiding the cost of modeling surrounding objects.
